newsitem.title: BRAZIL: German arrested for smuggling spiders from Brazil.
newsitem.headline: German arrested for smuggling spiders from Brazil.

text.p: Brazilian police arrested a 27-year-old German man for trying to smuggle 112 bird spiders out of the country, a police spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
She said Marc Baumgarten was arrested at Rio de Janeiro's international airport on Saturday as he was about to board a flight to Dusseldorf, Germany, with 112 bird spiders in his luggage.
Baumgarten was charged with wildlife smuggling and faces one to three years in prison if convicted.

Police believe he wanted to smuggle the spiders to extract their poison, which is used for pharmaceutical research purposes. The spiders, worth $30 to $50 each, have been taken to Rio de Janeiro's zoo, the spokeswoman said.
Brazil loses 12 million animals a year through illegal animal trade worth an annual $500 million to $700 million, which is five to seven percent of the world's $10 billion market.
